feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: How Orchestra Noir turned classical music into a cultural movement
entry.summary: Orchestra Noir is back on tour, selling out stages across the country and proving classical music can be anything you want it to be.

entry.title: Trump to hold press conference after meeting with Xi and Putin
entry.summary: Trump did not formally take questions while in China at the end of his trip, though it's typically expected on presidential foreign trips.

entry.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
entry.summary: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.

entry.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa
entry.summary: Congress needs to pass a funding measure to avoid a shutdown next month, providing Dems an opportunity to leverage power. And, the Army says waiting to detonate lead azide could become dangerous.

entry.title: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
entry.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

entry.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
entry.summary: "We're not going to shut down the war," Sen. Ron Johnson said as Republicans and Democrats struggle to reach a government funding deal.

entry.title: Senate passes bipartisan energy bill amid environmental concerns
entry.summary: As Americans struggle with rising energy costs and increased demand driven by AI, the Senate passed a bipartisan bill that will speed up the approval process for data centers and power plants.

entry.title: New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
entry.summary: New York City officials are moving forward with plans to close Rikers, the city's main jail complex, after years of discussion. The jail has been plagued by assaults and inmate deaths.

entry.title: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
entry.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

entry.title: Critics are calling what brand-new release a masterpiece? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus: Are you up to date on your James Bond news? If so, you'll get at least one question right.
